credit_card.late_fee_policy: If this is the customer's first late fee, we can waive it. Otherwise, the late fee is $35.
credit_card.card_declined: Check if the card is locked in the app. If not, the fraud department may have flagged a suspicious transaction.
credit_card.cash_withdrawal: Cash withdrawals may be declined if the account has insufficient available funds or the daily withdrawal limit has been reached.
credit_card.payment_due: Customers should make at least the minimum payment by the due date to avoid a late fee and potential negative credit reporting.
credit_card.lost_or_stolen_card: Customers should immediately lock the card in the app and contact customer support to request a replacement.
credit_card.credit_limit: Credit limits are determined based on factors such as credit history, income, and existing debt. Customers can request a review for a higher limit.
credit_card.foreign_transaction: Foreign transactions may include a currency conversion fee depending on the card type and transaction.
credit_card.cash_advance: Cash advances may have additional fees and interest that begin accruing immediately.
credit_card.card_activation: New credit cards must be activated before they can be used.
credit_card.replacement_card: Replacement cards are issued for lost, stolen, damaged, or expired cards.
credit_card.minimum_payment: The minimum payment is the lowest amount the customer must pay by the due date.
credit_card.statement_balance: The statement balance is the amount owed at the end of the billing cycle.
credit_card.card_expired: Expired cards cannot be used and require a replacement card.
credit_card.merchant_dispute: Customers who do not recognize a transaction should review the transaction and contact the bank if they believe it is unauthorized.
credit_card.contactless_payment: Contactless payments may occasionally require the customer to insert the card and enter a PIN.
credit_card.duplicate_charge: Customers who see the same transaction charged twice should contact the bank so the duplicate charge can be reviewed.
credit_card.card_payment_reversed: A reversed card payment means a previously authorized transaction was cancelled or returned.
credit_card.available_credit: Available credit is the amount remaining on the card after accounting for posted and pending transactions.
credit_card.payment_reversal: A credit card payment may be reversed if the original payment cannot be completed or is returned.
credit_card.annual_fee: Some credit cards charge an annual fee depending on the card product and account terms.
credit_card.interest_charge: Interest may be charged on balances that are not paid according to the terms of the card agreement.
credit_card.pending_card_transaction: Pending card transactions may temporarily reduce available credit until the transaction is completed or released.
credit_card.card_pin: Customers who forget their card PIN should use the bank's approved PIN reset or replacement process.
credit_card.merchant_credit: Refunds from merchants may take several business days to appear on the credit card account.
credit_card.card_security: Customers should never share their full card number, security code, PIN, or one-time verification code with another person.

mortgages_and_loans.loan_denied: Loan amounts are based on credit history and debt-to-income ratio. Customers can re-apply in 90 days.
mortgages_and_loans.loan_payment: Customers should make their loan payment by the due date to avoid late fees and potential negative credit reporting.
mortgages_and_loans.interest_rate: Interest rates may vary based on the loan type, credit history, loan amount, and current lending conditions.
mortgages_and_loans.early_repayment: Customers may repay a loan early. Any early repayment fee depends on the specific loan agreement.
mortgages_and_loans.missed_payment: A missed loan payment may result in a late fee and may be reported to credit bureaus if it becomes significantly overdue.
mortgages_and_loans.loan_balance: Customers can check their outstanding principal, interest, and payment schedule through the banking app or customer support.
mortgages_and_loans.refinancing: Customers may be eligible to refinance an existing loan depending on their credit profile, income, and current loan terms.
mortgages_and_loans.loan_application: Customers may be asked to provide identification, income information, employment details, and other financial documents.
mortgages_and_loans.loan_disbursement: Approved loan funds are released after all required documents and approval conditions are completed.
mortgages_and_loans.mortgage_payment: Mortgage payments may include principal, interest, taxes, insurance, and other applicable charges.
mortgages_and_loans.payment_extension: Customers experiencing financial difficulty should contact the bank before missing a payment to ask about available assistance.
mortgages_and_loans.loan_documentation: Customers may be required to provide proof of income, identification, employment information, and supporting documents.
mortgages_and_loans.co_borrower: A co-borrower may be added to a loan application subject to eligibility and underwriting requirements.
mortgages_and_loans.loan_term: The loan term determines how long the customer has to repay the loan.
mortgages_and_loans.mortgage_down_payment: Down-payment requirements depend on the mortgage product and the customer's financial circumstances.
mortgages_and_loans.loan_processing_time: Loan applications may require several business days for document review and approval.
mortgages_and_loans.loan_payment_date_change: Customers may request a change to their payment date, subject to the loan agreement and bank approval.
mortgages_and_loans.loan_statement: Customers can request or access a statement showing the current loan balance, payments, and interest.
mortgages_and_loans.mortgage_insurance: Some mortgages may require mortgage insurance depending on the loan structure and down payment.
mortgages_and_loans.loan_interest_calculation: Interest charges are calculated according to the interest rate, outstanding balance, and terms of the loan.
mortgages_and_loans.mortgage_property_insurance: Mortgage customers may be required to maintain valid property insurance for the financed property.
mortgages_and_loans.loan_application_status: Customers can contact the bank or check online banking to review the current status of a loan application.
mortgages_and_loans.loan_rejection_reason: When permitted, customers may request information about the general factors that contributed to a loan application being declined.
mortgages_and_loans.income_verification: The bank may request updated income information before approving or renewing certain loans.
mortgages_and_loans.mortgage_escrow: Some mortgage payments may include an escrow amount for taxes and insurance.

credit_reporting.credit_score: Credit scores are influenced by factors such as payment history, credit utilization, account age, and recent credit activity.
credit_reporting.late_payment_reporting: Late payments may be reported to credit bureaus once they meet the reporting requirements and are sufficiently overdue.
credit_reporting.credit_report_error: Customers who believe information on their credit report is incorrect should contact the bank and may also dispute the information with the credit bureau.
credit_reporting.credit_inquiry: Applying for certain credit products may result in a hard inquiry, which can temporarily affect the customer's credit score.
credit_reporting.credit_utilization: Using a high percentage of available revolving credit can negatively affect a credit score.
credit_reporting.credit_limit_change: A change in the credit limit may affect the customer's credit utilization ratio.
credit_reporting.account_closure: Closing a credit account can change credit utilization and may affect the average age of accounts.
credit_reporting.reporting_frequency: Account balances and payment information may be reported periodically rather than immediately after every transaction.
credit_reporting.paid_debt_reporting: After a debt is paid, the account status may be updated in a later reporting cycle.
credit_reporting.credit_report_request: Customers can request a copy of their credit report from the applicable credit reporting agency.
credit_reporting.identity_theft: Customers who find unauthorized accounts on their credit report should contact the bank and credit reporting agency promptly.
credit_reporting.address_update: Customers should keep their personal information up to date to help ensure account information is accurate.
credit_reporting.payment_history: Consistently making payments on time can help maintain a positive credit history.
credit_reporting.credit_account_age: The length of time credit accounts have been open can be a factor in credit scoring.
credit_reporting.incorrect_account_status: Customers who believe an account is incorrectly marked as open, closed, delinquent, or paid should request a review.
credit_reporting.incorrect_balance: Customers should contact the bank if a reported credit balance does not match their account records.
credit_reporting.duplicate_account: If the same account appears multiple times on a credit report, the customer can request an investigation.
credit_reporting.unknown_credit_inquiry: Customers who do not recognize a credit inquiry should review it and report possible unauthorized activity.
credit_reporting.bankruptcy_reporting: Certain financial events may remain on a credit report according to applicable reporting rules.
credit_reporting.credit_monitoring: Customers can use credit-monitoring services to track changes to their credit report.
credit_reporting.dispute_processing: Credit report disputes may require supporting documents and time for investigation.
credit_reporting.credit_report_update: A corrected account record may not appear immediately because credit reporting updates occur periodically.
credit_reporting.delinquency_status: An account may be reported as delinquent when required payments remain unpaid according to the account terms.
credit_reporting.hard_vs_soft_inquiry: Hard inquiries may affect credit scores, while soft inquiries generally do not affect the score.
credit_reporting.credit_history_length: Maintaining older accounts in good standing can contribute to a longer credit history.

debt_collection.overdue_account: Accounts that remain unpaid for an extended period may be transferred to a collections department.
debt_collection.payment_plan: Customers experiencing financial difficulty may contact the bank to ask whether a repayment plan or other assistance is available.
debt_collection.collection_contact: Customers should verify the identity of the person contacting them about a debt before sharing sensitive account information.
debt_collection.debt_dispute: Customers who believe a debt is incorrect should provide the relevant details and supporting documentation so the account can be reviewed.
debt_collection.collection_fee: Additional fees or collection costs may apply depending on the account terms and applicable regulations.
debt_collection.partial_payment: A partial payment may reduce the outstanding balance but does not necessarily stop collection activity unless an agreement has been made.
debt_collection.settlement: Some customers may be offered a settlement arrangement, subject to approval and the terms of the account.
debt_collection.payment_confirmation: Customers should keep confirmation numbers or receipts for payments made toward a collection account.
debt_collection.collection_status: Customers can contact the bank to request information about the current status and balance of a collection account.
debt_collection.financial_hardship: Customers experiencing financial hardship should contact the bank as early as possible to discuss available assistance options.
debt_collection.wrong_person: Customers who are contacted about a debt that does not belong to them should inform the bank and provide relevant information.
debt_collection.duplicate_payment: Customers who believe they made duplicate payments should provide payment details so the account can be reviewed.
debt_collection.payment_method: Available payment methods for collection accounts depend on the bank and account arrangements.
debt_collection.collection_resolution: Once an agreed debt has been fully resolved, the bank may update the account status according to its reporting procedures.
debt_collection.collections_phone_number: Customers should use official bank contact information when communicating about a collection account.
debt_collection.collection_balance: Customers may request the current outstanding balance before making a payment.
debt_collection.payment_arrangement: Any agreed payment arrangement should clearly state the amount, frequency, and due dates of payments.
debt_collection.missed_collection_payment: Missing an agreed collection payment may cause the account to return to standard collection activity.
debt_collection.collection_letter: Customers who receive a collection notice should review the notice carefully and contact the bank through an official channel.
debt_collection.debt_validation: Customers may request information used to verify the debt before making arrangements to resolve it.
debt_collection.settlement_confirmation: Customers should keep written confirmation of any approved settlement agreement.
debt_collection.automatic_payment: Customers may be able to set up automatic payments if the available collection payment system supports it.
debt_collection.account_reinstatement: A collection account may not automatically return to its previous status after payment and may require account review.
debt_collection.collection_dispute_status: Customers can contact the bank to ask about the status of a submitted debt dispute.
debt_collection.financial_assistance: Customers who cannot afford the requested payment should contact the bank and explain their financial circumstances.

retail_banking.account_balance: Customers can check their current and available balance through the mobile app, online banking, ATM, or branch.
retail_banking.account_transfer: Customers can transfer funds between eligible accounts, subject to transfer limits and applicable processing times.
retail_banking.atm_issue: If an ATM does not dispense cash correctly, customers should keep the receipt and report the issue to the bank as soon as possible.
retail_banking.cash_deposit: Cash deposits may be subject to verification, processing times, and applicable deposit limits.
retail_banking.wire_transfer: Wire transfers require accurate recipient information and may include fees depending on the destination and transfer type.
retail_banking.account_fees: Certain checking or savings accounts may have monthly maintenance, overdraft, transfer, or other service fees.
retail_banking.overdraft: Transactions that exceed the available account balance may be declined or may result in an overdraft fee depending on account settings.
retail_banking.password_or_pin: Customers should never share their online banking password, PIN, or one-time security codes with anyone.
retail_banking.account_closure: Customers who want to close an account should ensure pending transactions are completed and the remaining balance is handled.
retail_banking.direct_deposit: Direct deposits are generally credited according to the sending institution's processing schedule.
retail_banking.account_opening: Customers must provide the required identification and personal information when opening a new bank account.
retail_banking.mobile_banking: Customers can use the mobile banking app to view balances, transfer funds, manage cards, and review transactions.
retail_banking.online_banking_login: Customers who forget their online banking password should use the official password-reset process.
retail_banking.check_deposit: Check deposits may be subject to verification and funds may not be immediately available.
retail_banking.savings_account: Savings accounts may have withdrawal limits, fees, or minimum balance requirements depending on the account.
retail_banking.transaction_pending: A pending transaction may temporarily reduce the customer's available balance.
retail_banking.beneficiary: Customers may be able to add or update beneficiaries for eligible accounts.
retail_banking.personal_information_update: Customers should update their contact information when their phone number, email address, or mailing address changes.
retail_banking.bank_statement: Customers can access account statements through online banking or request assistance from customer support.
retail_banking.cash_withdrawal_limit: ATM cash withdrawals may be limited by a daily withdrawal limit.
retail_banking.transfer_failed: A bank transfer may fail because of incorrect recipient information, insufficient funds, or account restrictions.
retail_banking.scheduled_transfer: Customers may schedule future transfers between eligible accounts.
retail_banking.international_transfer: International transfers may require additional information and may include transfer or currency conversion fees.
retail_banking.atm_card_retained: If an ATM keeps the customer's card, the customer should contact the bank immediately and follow the card replacement procedure.
retail_banking.account_frozen: An account may be temporarily restricted because of security concerns, legal requirements, or verification issues.
retail_banking.deposit_verification: Certain deposits may require additional verification before funds become available.
retail_banking.standing_order: Customers may set up recurring payments or transfers when supported by their account.
retail_banking.transaction_history: Customers can review recent account activity through online banking, the mobile app, or account statements.
retail_banking.branch_services: Certain services may require an in-person branch visit depending on the transaction and account type.
retail_banking.phone_number_change: Customers should update their phone number promptly to ensure they can receive security alerts and verification messages.
